_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Through the Pipes#001.src: You're a lifesaver, {u}. I cannot thank you enough!
Through the Pipes#001.dst: Hayatımı kurtardın, {u}. Sana ne kadar teşekkür etsem az!

Through the Pipes#002.src: WAIT! MY ART BAG IS MISSING! Did I accidentally drop it somewhere?
Through the Pipes#002.dst: DUR! SANAT ÇANTAM KAYIP! Yanlışlıkla bir yere mi düşürdüm?

Through the Pipes#003.src: Do you want us to sink?!

similar.text: So you want us to sneak in?

Through the Pipes#004.src: What's your name... {u}? Great, I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#004.dst: Adın neydi... {u} mi? Harika, ben de o serseriyi aramaya devam edeceğim. Bol şans!

Through the Pipes#006.src: Maybe it's best to continue forward...
Through the Pipes#006.dst: Belki ilerlemeye devam etmek en iyisi...

Through the Pipes#008.src: You hear someone in the distance.

Through the Pipes#009.src: I'm so glad you found it! I don't know what I would do if I lost Soosu's gift and my bag!
Through the Pipes#009.dst: Bulmana çok sevindim! Soosu'nun hediyesini ve çantamı kaybetsem ne yapardım bilmiyorum!

Through the Pipes#010.src: You are? Excellent! Let's see what you've created.
Through the Pipes#010.dst: Öyle mi? Harika! Bakalım neler yapmışsın.

Through the Pipes#012.src: Are you sure you want to leave the dock?

Through the Pipes#015.src: You pull the hook off of the grapple. It might be useful later.
Through the Pipes#015.dst: Kancayı kanca tabancasından söküyorsun. Sonra işe yarayabilir.

Through the Pipes#017.src: You must be on your raft to use this.

Through the Pipes#018.src: Find a way to open that gate. I don't want to be on this raft for any longer!
Through the Pipes#018.dst: Şu kapıyı açmanın bir yolunu bul. Bu salda daha fazla kalmak istemiyorum!

Through the Pipes#020.src: Huh, this isn't- really what I expected.
Through the Pipes#020.dst: Hıh, bu pek- beklediğim gibi değil.

Through the Pipes#021.src: Are you sure you want to reset your raft?

Through the Pipes#022.src: Maybe there's something you could build to get across...
Through the Pipes#022.dst: Belki karşıya geçmek için yapabileceğin bir şey vardır...

Through the Pipes#023.src: That looks like enough leaf litter. You should return to the generator to fuel it now.
Through the Pipes#023.dst: Bu kadar yaprak döküntüsü yeterli görünüyor. Şimdi yakıt koymak için jeneratöre dönmelisin.

Through the Pipes#025.src: Especially considering how rarely Soosu shows up in public, this festival might be my only opportunity this year...
Through the Pipes#025.dst: Hele Soosu'nun ne kadar nadir halk içine çıktığını düşününce, bu festival bu yılki tek fırsatım olabilir...

Through the Pipes#026.src: You should let Fichu know you're done.

Through the Pipes#027.src: The board crumbles under your step. Maybe there's another way to the other side.
Through the Pipes#027.dst: Tahta ayağının altında ufalanıyor. Belki karşıya geçmenin başka bir yolu vardır.

Through the Pipes#028.src: Talk with the citizen in despair at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Through the Pipes#029.src: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
Through the Pipes#029.dst: H-Hey, sen! Buralarda bir rakun gördün mü?
Through the Pipes#029.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#030.src: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
Through the Pipes#030.dst: Bütün boş vaktimi Soosu için bir hediye yapmaya harcadım, o şeytan da elimden kaptı! Ona hediyeyi verme şansım hiç olmazsa çok yazık olur...
Through the Pipes#030.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#031.src: This might be a big ask, but- do you think you could help me?
Through the Pipes#031.dst: Büyük bir rica olabilir ama- bana yardım edebilir misin?
Through the Pipes#031.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#032.src: Y-You will? I knew there was some good left in this world!
Through the Pipes#032.dst: E-Edecek misin? Bu dünyada biraz iyilik kaldığını biliyordum!
Through the Pipes#032.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#033.src: Right! Last time I saw that raccoon, it was running into an alleyway south of the town center. It can't have gone too far!
Through the Pipes#033.dst: Tamam! O rakunu en son gördüğümde kasaba merkezinin güneyindeki bir ara sokağa koşuyordu. Çok uzağa gitmiş olamaz!
Through the Pipes#033.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#034.src: I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#034.dst: Ben de o serseriyi aramaya devam edeceğim. Bol şans!
Through the Pipes#034.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#035.src: ...I get it. If you change your mind, come and talk with me again.
Through the Pipes#035.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#036.src: Yes! A raccoon! You've seen them before- surely? They're rampant around here!
Through the Pipes#036.dst: Evet! Bir rakun! Daha önce görmüşsündür- herhalde? Buralarda kaynıyorlar!
Through the Pipes#036.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#038.src: You know, those furry gray creatures with the weird striped tails?
Through the Pipes#038.dst: Bilirsin işte, tuhaf çizgili kuyrukları olan tüylü gri yaratıklar?
Through the Pipes#038.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#039.src: ...I hope you know what a raccoon is.
Through the Pipes#039.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#041.src: Oh- you're back! Are you able to help me now?
Through the Pipes#041.dst: Ah- döndün! Şimdi bana yardım edebilir misin?
Through the Pipes#041.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#043.src: I really think it would be better if we split up to search, don't you agree?
Through the Pipes#043.dst: Bence ayrılıp aramamız daha iyi olur, sen de öyle düşünmüyor musun?
Through the Pipes#043.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#044.src: If you forgot, you should try searching south of the town center. But you do you, I suppose...
Through the Pipes#044.dst: Unuttuysan kasaba merkezinin güneyinde aramayı deneyebilirsin. Ama sen bilirsin tabii...
Through the Pipes#044.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#047.src: Enter the drainage hole at to continue the search.
Through the Pipes#047.dst: Aramaya devam etmek için drenaj deliğine gir.

Through the Pipes#048.src: Dive deeper into the sewer network.

Through the Pipes#050.src: Find a way to get across the flooded section of the sewer.
Through the Pipes#050.dst: Kanalizasyonun su basmış bölümünden karşıya geçmenin bir yolunu bul.

Through the Pipes#051.src: Huh, is there someone down there?

Through the Pipes#053.src: Continue chasing the raccoon through the sewers.

Through the Pipes#054.src: You aren't getting away from me now!

Through the Pipes#055.src: Encounter a familiar face in the sewers.

Through the Pipes#056.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#060.src: {u}! You're here! I was wondering where you went!
Through the Pipes#060.dst: {u}! Buradasın! Nereye gittin diye merak ediyordum!
Through the Pipes#060.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#061.src: I've been chasing that raccoon the whole time! What in the world have you been up to?
Through the Pipes#061.dst: Bunca zamandır o rakunu kovalıyorum! Sen ne yapıyordun Allah aşkına?
Through the Pipes#061.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#062.src: Whatever. I'm struggling to keep up the chase at this rate. But fortunately, I have just the thing that'll help you!
Through the Pipes#062.dst: Neyse. Bu gidişle kovalamacaya ayak uydurmakta zorlanıyorum. Ama neyse ki tam da sana yardım edecek bir şeyim var!
Through the Pipes#062.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#064.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#064.dst: Kırılmış! Bu gidişle o hırsıza nasıl yetişeceğim?
Through the Pipes#064.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#065.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#065.dst: ...Belki de bu boşuna bir çaba. İstersen tamir etmeyi deneyebilirsin ama değmez.
Through the Pipes#065.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#066.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#066.dst: Ben o haşereyi yakalayabilir miyim diye o tarafa gidiyorum. Sen öbür taraftan git, yakında yine buluşuruz.
Through the Pipes#066.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#067.src: Encounter the stranger in the sewers.

Through the Pipes#073.src: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Through the Pipes#073.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#074.src: Ah, exploring the sewers? That's fun! I've basically been to every corner of {p}'s sewers.
Through the Pipes#074.dst: Ha, kanalizasyonu mu keşfediyorsun? Eğlenceli! Ben {p} kanalizasyonunun neredeyse her köşesini gezdim.
Through the Pipes#074.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#075.src: Say, is there any chance you stumbled upon that raccoon earlier? That pest snatched something of value from me!
Through the Pipes#075.dst: Baksana, az önce o rakuna denk gelmiş olabilir misin? O haşere benden değerli bir şey kaptı!
Through the Pipes#075.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#076.src: I was making a gift for Sovereign Soosu, but then that fiend just ran off with it! Horrible, isn't it?
Through the Pipes#076.dst: Hükümdar Soosu için bir hediye yapıyordum, o alçak da alıp kaçtı! Korkunç, değil mi?
Through the Pipes#076.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#077.src: Especially with how soon the festival is... I wouldn't want to miss my only opportunity this year!
Through the Pipes#077.dst: Hele festival bu kadar yakınken... Bu yılki tek fırsatımı kaçırmak istemem!
Through the Pipes#077.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#078.src: I could really use your help, and hey- I have just the tool you'll want for exploring the sewers!
Through the Pipes#078.dst: Yardımına gerçekten ihtiyacım var, hem bak, kanalizasyonu keşfetmek için tam sana göre bir aletim var!
Through the Pipes#078.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#082.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. What's your name... {u}? You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#082.dst: Ben o haşereyi yakalayabilir miyim diye o tarafa gidiyorum. Adın neydi... {u} mi? Sen öbür taraftan git, yakında yine buluşuruz.
Through the Pipes#082.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#083.src: Find a safe way past the flooded rail tunnels.
Through the Pipes#083.dst: Su basmış ray tünellerinden güvenle geçmenin bir yolunu bul.

Through the Pipes#084.src: Whew! I didn't mean to let go-
Through the Pipes#084.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#086.src: Perfect, I know where we are, and there isn't much further that foolish raccoon can run. We could corner it!
Through the Pipes#086.dst: Mükemmel, nerede olduğumuzu biliyorum, o aptal rakunun kaçabileceği pek bir yer kalmadı. Onu köşeye sıkıştırabiliriz!
Through the Pipes#086.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#087.src: Now, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#087.dst: Ama sorun şu ki, bu sonraki bölgeden nasıl geçeceğimizi hiç bilmiyorum. Hatırladığım kadarıyla her yeri su basmış.
Through the Pipes#087.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#088.src: {u}! OH NO! I didn't mean to drop that on you-
Through the Pipes#088.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#089.src: W-why were you standing there? Out of all places?
Through the Pipes#089.dst: N-neden orada duruyordun? Onca yer varken?
Through the Pipes#089.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#090.src: ...Okay. You seem to be alright. Sorry, I didn't realize you were standing right there!
Through the Pipes#090.dst: ...Tamam. İyi görünüyorsun. Kusura bakma, tam orada durduğunu fark etmemiştim!
Through the Pipes#090.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#091.src: Alright, at least we're regrouped now. Try not to stand under any more heavy objects, alright?
Through the Pipes#091.dst: Peki, en azından artık yeniden bir aradayız. Başka ağır şeylerin altında durmamaya çalış, tamam mı?
Through the Pipes#091.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#092.src: Moving forward, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#092.dst: Devam edersek, sorun şu ki bu sonraki bölgeden nasıl geçeceğimizi hiç bilmiyorum. Hatırladığım kadarıyla her yeri su basmış.
Through the Pipes#092.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#093.src: You'll need to find some way for us to cross. Too many people have gotten the worst of diseases by wading through that water- eugh.
Through the Pipes#093.dst: Karşıya geçmemiz için bir yol bulman gerekecek. O suyun içinden yürüyen çok kişi en kötü hastalıklara yakalandı- iğrenç.
Through the Pipes#093.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#094.src: Right! Let me know when you figure something out. I'll scout around, never had an excuse to explore this area before!
Through the Pipes#094.dst: Tamam! Bir şey bulunca haber ver. Ben etrafa bakınacağım, daha önce burayı keşfetmek için hiç bahanem olmamıştı!
Through the Pipes#094.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#095.src: Huh? What's all this stuff? Did someone forget their construction equipment?
Through the Pipes#095.dst: Hıh? Bütün bu şeyler de ne? Biri inşaat malzemelerini mi unutmuş?
Through the Pipes#095.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#096.src: I guess the maintenance crews never bother to pack up their equipment. Maybe you can use this stuff for something.
Through the Pipes#096.dst: Galiba bakım ekipleri malzemelerini toplamaya hiç zahmet etmiyor. Belki bunları bir şey için kullanabilirsin.
Through the Pipes#096.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#097.src: Check back in with me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#097.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#098.src: Navigate through the end of the sewer network with Fichu.
Through the Pipes#098.dst: Fichu ile kanalizasyon ağının sonuna kadar ilerle.

Through the Pipes#101.src: I'd appreciate it if you added a seat for me.
Through the Pipes#101.dst: Bana da oturacak bir yer eklersen sevinirim.
Through the Pipes#101.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#105.src: Bet no one's been here for a while.
Through the Pipes#105.dst: Bahse girerim uzun zamandır buraya kimse gelmemiştir.
Through the Pipes#105.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#106.src: Wonder where that raccoon is now...
Through the Pipes#106.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#107.src: Soosu needs to see that state of this place...
Through the Pipes#107.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#109.src: What else do you think we'll find?
Through the Pipes#109.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#110.src: I've heard a few stories about this place. Mostly bad ones...
Through the Pipes#110.dst: Burası hakkında birkaç hikâye duydum. Çoğu kötü...
Through the Pipes#110.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#111.src: I hope that raccoon hasn't gone too far...
Through the Pipes#111.dst: Umarım o rakun çok uzağa gitmemiştir...
Through the Pipes#111.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#114.src: This raft looks fragile, be careful!
Through the Pipes#114.dst: Bu sal çürük görünüyor, dikkatli ol!
Through the Pipes#114.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#119.src: You know what you're doing, right?
Through the Pipes#119.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#121.src: Ah! I almost fell out of my seat.
Through the Pipes#121.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#123.src: Are you even capable of not hitting something?
Through the Pipes#123.dst: Bir şeye çarpmadan durabiliyor musun sen?
Through the Pipes#123.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#124.src: One more hit and I'm taking over!
Through the Pipes#124.dst: Bir çarpma daha olursa dümeni ben alırım!
Through the Pipes#124.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#125.src: I don't trust you sailing this thing!
Through the Pipes#125.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#127.src: It can't possibly be that hard!
Through the Pipes#127.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#128.src: Make sure to be careful, okay?
Through the Pipes#128.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#129.src: No wonder everyone avoids this place...
Through the Pipes#129.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#131.src: You know where you're going, right?
Through the Pipes#131.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#132.src: When I get that raccoon, oh man...
Through the Pipes#132.dst: O rakunu bir yakalarsam, ah ah...
Through the Pipes#132.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#133.src: How long have I even spent chasing that fool...
Through the Pipes#133.dst: O serseriyi kovalarken ne kadar zaman harcadım ki...
Through the Pipes#133.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#135.src: Keep an eye out for dangers!
Through the Pipes#135.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#136.src: Make sure we're staying on track.
Through the Pipes#136.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#137.src: Maybe rats are better than raccoons after all.
Through the Pipes#137.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#138.src: I regret getting on this raft.
Through the Pipes#138.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#142.src: I cannot wait to get off...
Through the Pipes#142.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#144.src: I really don't want to insult you, but-
Through the Pipes#144.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#150.src: Ah! What will we do now?!
Through the Pipes#150.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#152.src: Hmm, is the raft broken? We haven't moved for a while.
Through the Pipes#152.dst: Hmm, sal bozuldu mu? Bir süredir kıpırdamadık.
Through the Pipes#152.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#153.src: Are you... going to have us move?
Through the Pipes#153.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#156.src: I'm not sure why you think this place is interesting enough to stop at.
Through the Pipes#156.dst: Burayı durmaya değecek kadar neden ilginç bulduğunu anlamadım.
Through the Pipes#156.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#160.src: The raccoon is probably long gone at this point, thanks to your delay.
Through the Pipes#160.dst: Senin oyalanman yüzünden rakun çoktan gitmiştir.
Through the Pipes#160.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#163.src: How long were we waiting for?
Through the Pipes#163.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#164.src: Huh? What are you doing with that?!
Through the Pipes#164.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#165.src: You're going to sink us with that!
Through the Pipes#165.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#167.src: IS THAT AN EXPLOSIVE?! ARE YOU MAD!
Through the Pipes#167.dst: O BİR PATLAYICI MI?! ÇILDIRDIN MI!
Through the Pipes#167.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#168.src: HELP US! WE'RE GOING TO DROWN!
Through the Pipes#168.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#169.src: OH NO! GET ME OFF OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#169.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#172.src: Why did you think this was a good idea?!
Through the Pipes#172.dst: Bunun iyi bir fikir olduğunu nereden çıkardın?!
Through the Pipes#172.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#173.src: I gotta get off of this thing!
Through the Pipes#173.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#174.src: That's the exit! Go past this gate, then I never want to board anything sailed by you again!
Through the Pipes#174.dst: İşte çıkış! Bu kapıdan geç, sonra senin sürdüğün hiçbir şeye bir daha binmek istemiyorum!

Through the Pipes#175.src: I gotta get off this thing!
Through the Pipes#175.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#176.src: Hey- maybe we should've been a bit further away from that train?
Through the Pipes#176.dst: Hey- belki o trenden biraz daha uzak durmalıydık?
Through the Pipes#176.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#179.src: Agh! Sorry, just got scared by that.
Through the Pipes#179.dst: Agh! Kusura bakma, ondan korktum da.
Through the Pipes#179.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#180.src: AHHHHH! THIS WAS A HORRIBLE IDEA!
Through the Pipes#180.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#181.src: OUT OF ALL ROUTES YOU TOOK, ONE OF THEM INCLUDED A TRAIN!
Through the Pipes#181.dst: ONCA YOL VARKEN, BİRİNDE TREN VARDI!
Through the Pipes#181.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#183.src: Huh? AH! THERE'S A TRAIN! GET OUT OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#183.dst: Hıh? AH! TREN VAR! ÇIK BURADAN!
Through the Pipes#183.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#186.src: YOU REALLY THINK THIS FLIMSY RAFT IS GOING TO SURVIVE A TRAIN?!
Through the Pipes#186.dst: BU ÇÜRÜK SALIN BİR TRENDEN SAĞ ÇIKACAĞINI MI SANIYORSUN?!
Through the Pipes#186.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#187.src: YOU FOOL! We barely missed being hit!
Through the Pipes#187.dst: SENİ APTAL! Çarpılmaktan kıl payı kurtulduk!
Through the Pipes#187.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#188.src: Oh my- we survived! YOU ARE AN IDIOT! DON'T DO THAT AGAIN!
Through the Pipes#188.dst: Aman- sağ kaldık! SEN BİR SALAKSIN! BİR DAHA YAPMA!
Through the Pipes#188.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#189.src: This looks like the halfway point!
Through the Pipes#189.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#190.src: You'll need to find a way to open that gate, since I don't see any other way past.
Through the Pipes#190.dst: O kapıyı açmanın bir yolunu bulman gerekecek, çünkü geçmenin başka yolunu göremiyorum.
Through the Pipes#190.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#191.src: If I'm remembering correctly, just past this gate should be our destination!
Through the Pipes#191.dst: Doğru hatırlıyorsam, bu kapının hemen ötesi varacağımız yer olmalı!
Through the Pipes#191.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#192.src: Phew, we survived. That was a bit rough, but at least we made it.
Through the Pipes#192.dst: Ohh, sağ kaldık. Biraz zorlu oldu ama en azından başardık.
Through the Pipes#192.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#193.src: However, I think I'll definitely be avoiding boats for now...
Through the Pipes#193.dst: Ama sanırım bir süre teknelerden kesinlikle uzak duracağım...
Through the Pipes#193.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#194.src: We made it! You did a pretty good job navigating, I knew I could trust you!
Through the Pipes#194.dst: Başardık! Epey iyi dümen kullandın, sana güvenebileceğimi biliyordum!
Through the Pipes#194.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#195.src: Alright, let's chase down that raccoon once and for all!
Through the Pipes#195.dst: Pekâlâ, o rakunu bu sefer kesin yakalayalım!
Through the Pipes#195.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#196.src: I hope my prediction is right, and there really is no further it can run from here.
Through the Pipes#196.dst: Umarım tahminim doğrudur ve buradan kaçabileceği başka yer yoktur.
Through the Pipes#196.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#198.src: Huh?! LOOK! It's the raccoon, that's it!
Through the Pipes#198.dst: Hıh?! BAK! Rakun bu, o işte!
Through the Pipes#198.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#201.src: Ah ha! Now you're cornered, you little imp!
Through the Pipes#201.dst: Aha! Artık köşeye sıkıştın, seni küçük şeytan!
Through the Pipes#201.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#202.src: Before you do anything, we need a way to take the gift back!
Through the Pipes#202.dst: Bir şey yapmadan önce hediyeyi geri almanın bir yolunu bulmalıyız!
Through the Pipes#202.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#204.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#204.dst: Bak! Sonunda hediyeyi geri aldık! Yapabileceğimizi biliyordum.
Through the Pipes#204.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#205.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#205.dst: Umarım bunca şeyden sonra hâlâ sağlamdır...
Through the Pipes#205.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#206.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#206.dst: Sağlam kalmış! Kraliçeye şükürler olsun! Yoksa ne yapardım bilmiyorum...
Through the Pipes#206.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#207.src: {u}, from the very start, you have been a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#207.dst: {u}, en başından beri bana çok büyük yardımın dokundu. Emeklerin için sana ne kadar teşekkür etsem az!
Through the Pipes#207.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#208.src: ...You don't think that was a little too brutal, do you?
Through the Pipes#208.dst: ...Sence bu biraz fazla acımasız değil miydi?

Through the Pipes#209.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#209.dst: {u}, en başından beri bana çok büyük yardımın dokundu. Emeklerin için sana ne kadar teşekkür etsem az!
Through the Pipes#209.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#210.src: Without your help, I don't even know if I could have caught that raccoon on my own!
Through the Pipes#210.dst: Senin yardımın olmasa o rakunu tek başıma yakalayabilir miydim bilmiyorum bile!
Through the Pipes#210.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#211.src: As a reward, I have an extra gift just for you! Thank you again for your incredible help!
Through the Pipes#211.dst: Ödül olarak sadece sana özel fazladan bir hediyem var! Muhteşem yardımın için tekrar teşekkürler!
Through the Pipes#211.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#216.src: Not only did you safely get us through a flooded tunnel with- that creation of yours, but you came more prepared than I could have expected!
Through the Pipes#216.dst: Yaptığın o şeyle bizi su basmış tünelden güvenle geçirmekle kalmadın, beklediğimden çok daha hazırlıklı geldin!
Through the Pipes#216.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#217.src: A cage... a ring to use as a distraction... and even a firecracker. Where did you even find all this stuff?
Through the Pipes#217.dst: Bir kafes... dikkat dağıtmak için bir yüzük... hatta bir havai fişek. Bütün bunları nereden buldun?
Through the Pipes#217.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#218.src: And on top of all of that, you found my art supplies bag! That bag itself is more important to me than the gift we were chasing after!
Through the Pipes#218.dst: Üstelik sanat malzemesi çantamı da buldun! O çanta benim için peşinden koştuğumuz hediyeden bile daha önemli!
Through the Pipes#218.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#219.src: Speaking of that, I would like to give you Soosu's gift as a token of appreciation. I believe you're more deserving of it.
Through the Pipes#219.dst: Lafı gelmişken, minnettarlığımın bir göstergesi olarak Soosu'nun hediyesini sana vermek istiyorum. Bence sen onu daha çok hak ediyorsun.
Through the Pipes#219.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#220.src: Don't worry, I've already brainstormed a better design. I think Soosu will like this next one even more!
Through the Pipes#220.dst: Merak etme, daha iyi bir tasarım çoktan düşündüm bile. Bence Soosu bir sonrakini daha da çok sevecek!
Through the Pipes#220.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#221.src: Don't go so close! You might scare it off again!
Through the Pipes#221.dst: Bu kadar yaklaşma! Yine korkutup kaçırabilirsin!
Through the Pipes#221.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#222.src: Thank you again for the help! I couldn't have done it without you.
Through the Pipes#222.dst: Yardımın için tekrar teşekkürler! Sensiz başaramazdım.
Through the Pipes#222.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#224.src:
If I see that raccoon...
Fichu
Through the Pipes#224.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#225.src: I'm rushing to finish a gift I made for Sovereign Soosu! The festival's gonna be this week, and I can't miss my opportunity to give it to her!
Through the Pipes#225.dst: Hükümdar Soosu için yaptığım bir hediyeyi bitirmeye çalışıyorum! Festival bu hafta ve ona hediyeyi verme fırsatını kaçıramam!
Through the Pipes#225.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#226.src: Just as I was about to add the finishing details, a raccoon snuck up on me and snatched it from my bag! Can you believe it?
Through the Pipes#226.dst: Tam son rötuşları ekleyecektim ki bir rakun sinsice yanıma sokulup onu çantamdan kaptı! İnanabiliyor musun?
Through the Pipes#226.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#228.src: Oh, you're wondering what the gift is? Well, that's a surprise!
Through the Pipes#228.dst: Ah, hediyenin ne olduğunu mu merak ediyorsun? Eh, o bir sürpriz!
Through the Pipes#228.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#229.src: It might be the best thing I've made all year. I really think Soosu would love it, especially for all of the work she's done for our district!
Through the Pipes#229.dst: Bu yıl yaptığım en iyi şey olabilir. Soosu'nun buna gerçekten bayılacağını düşünüyorum, hele bölgemiz için yaptığı onca işten sonra!
Through the Pipes#229.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#230.src: If you want to see it, you'll have to help me find it. How does that sound?
Through the Pipes#230.dst: Görmek istiyorsan onu bulmama yardım etmen gerekecek. Ne dersin?
Through the Pipes#230.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#231.src: The water seems to have cleared the debris.

Through the Pipes#232.src: It looks like a valve handle could fit into this slot.
Through the Pipes#232.dst: Bu yuvaya bir vana kolu oturabilir gibi görünüyor.

Through the Pipes#233.src:
{#} to add fuel to
 the generator
[{~}/{~}]

Through the Pipes#227.src: This water looks too dangerous to swim in.
Through the Pipes#227.dst: Bu su yüzmek için fazla tehlikeli görünüyor.

Through the Pipes#234.src: Different materials around the room can be used as raft parts.
Through the Pipes#234.dst: Odadaki farklı malzemeler sal parçası olarak kullanılabilir.

Through the Pipes#235.src:
{#} Right-Click to sail
{#} Left-Click to reset
Through the Pipes#235.dst:
{#} Yola çıkmak için Sağ Tık
{#} Sıfırlamak için Sol Tık

Through the Pipes#236.src: Some raft parts may have unique functions.
Through the Pipes#236.dst: Bazı sal parçalarının kendine özgü işlevleri olabilir.

Through the Pipes#237.src: Place the raft parts on the building mat to construct your raft.
Through the Pipes#237.dst: Salını yapmak için sal parçalarını inşa matının üzerine yerleştir.

Through the Pipes#239.src: Maybe you need to find a different method of propulsion.
Through the Pipes#239.dst: Belki farklı bir itme yöntemi bulman gerekiyor.

Through the Pipes#240.src: You must have a fully constructed raft to set sail.
Through the Pipes#240.dst: Yola çıkmak için tamamen inşa edilmiş bir salın olmalı.

Through the Pipes#241.src: The lever appears to be jammed. Maybe it needs power?
Through the Pipes#241.dst: Şalter sıkışmış gibi görünüyor. Belki elektriğe ihtiyacı vardır?

Through the Pipes#242.src: It looks like this station hasn't been powered in a very long time.
Through the Pipes#242.dst: Bu istasyona çok uzun zamandır elektrik verilmemiş gibi görünüyor.

Through the Pipes#243.src: Fortunately, it still seems to be accepting power.
Through the Pipes#243.dst: Neyse ki hâlâ elektrik alabiliyor gibi görünüyor.

Through the Pipes#244.src: You could fit this with a grappling hook.

Through the Pipes#245.src: You seem to have gone off track. Sadly, your raft isn't able to survive this far.
Through the Pipes#245.dst: Rotadan çıkmış gibisin. Ne yazık ki salın bu kadar uzağa dayanamıyor.

Through the Pipes#246.src: Your raft seems to have vanished into thin air. (Unknown error occured!)
Through the Pipes#246.dst: Salın bir anda buharlaşıp gitmiş gibi görünüyor. (Bilinmeyen bir hata oluştu!)

Through the Pipes#247.src: You shouldn't open this just yet.

Through the Pipes#249.dst:
Çalınacak ilginç bir şey yok...
Fichu
Through the Pipes#249.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#250.src:
But I would never steal, right?
Fichu
Through the Pipes#250.dst:
Ama ben asla hırsızlık yapmam, değil mi?
Fichu
Through the Pipes#250.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#251.src:
No wonder the water tastes so weird...
Fichu
Through the Pipes#251.dst:
Suyun tadının bu kadar tuhaf olmasına şaşmamalı...
Fichu
Through the Pipes#251.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#255.src:
This workbench is quite convenient.
Fichu
Through the Pipes#255.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#256.src: Oh, don't mind me. I'm just seeing if there's anything interesting here.
Through the Pipes#256.dst: Ah, bana aldırma. Sadece burada ilginç bir şey var mı diye bakıyorum.
Through the Pipes#256.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#257.src: Usually there's cool things to, well- steal, but this place seems to be a bust.
Through the Pipes#257.dst: Genelde, şey- çalınacak havalı şeyler olur, ama burası boş çıktı gibi.
Through the Pipes#257.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#258.src: There sure is a lot hidden underground, you wouldn't believe some of the things I've seen!
Through the Pipes#258.dst: Yeraltında gerçekten çok şey saklı, gördüğüm bazı şeylere inanamazsın!
Through the Pipes#258.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#259.src: They seem to be busy with something. You should check in later.
Through the Pipes#259.dst: Bir şeyle meşgul görünüyor. Sonra tekrar uğramalısın.

Through the Pipes#260.src: That's great to hear! I haven't found anything useful unfortunately.
Through the Pipes#260.dst: Bunu duyduğuma sevindim! Ne yazık ki ben işe yarar bir şey bulamadım.
Through the Pipes#260.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#261.src: I'm quite interested to see what you come up with, return to me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#261.dst: Ne bulacağını çok merak ediyorum, işin bitince yanıma gel!
Through the Pipes#261.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#262.src: You know what, not a bad idea! Let's give it a try!
Through the Pipes#262.dst: Biliyor musun, fena fikir değil! Bir deneyelim!
Through the Pipes#262.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#264.src: Trains are cool... not when they're speeding right next to you.
Through the Pipes#264.dst: Trenler havalıdır... yanı başında hızla geçmedikleri sürece.
Through the Pipes#264.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#265.src: Oh, thank the Queen! It's the halfway point.
Through the Pipes#265.dst: Ah, Kraliçeye şükürler olsun! Yolun yarısı burası.
Through the Pipes#265.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#266.src: Woah, that looks like an expensive ring! You really think the raccoon will take it?
Through the Pipes#266.dst: Vay, pahalı bir yüzüğe benziyor! Rakunun onu gerçekten alacağını mı düşünüyorsun?
Through the Pipes#266.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#267.src: Hold on, where did you even get that- nevermind, I won't ask any questions. Give it a try!
Through the Pipes#267.dst: Dur bir dakika, onu nereden buldun ki- boş ver, hiç soru sormayacağım. Bir dene!
Through the Pipes#267.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#270.src: I hope no one cared about that ring, because they sure aren't getting it back...
Through the Pipes#270.dst: Umarım o yüzük kimsenin umurunda değildi, çünkü onu kesinlikle geri alamayacaklar...
Through the Pipes#270.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#271.src: Great work! After all of that, we've finally gotten the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#271.dst: Harika iş! Bunca şeyden sonra sonunda hediyeyi geri aldık! Yapabileceğimizi biliyordum.
Through the Pipes#271.speaker: Fichu
